role: The five Protection enchantments (all, fire, fall, explosion, projectile): the per-type level windows plus calcModifierDamage, the formula EntityLivingBase.applyPotionDamageCalculations sums over the armour, and the two static fire/blast reducers.
scope_reason: The enchanting table is a plain block (world.conf enchanting=off), but the enchantment registry itself is kept: loot books and mob equipment carry enchantments (DEVLOG 2026-09-25, 'Kept: enchantment data and effects').

members.name: protectionType
members.note: which of the five rows (effect ids 0..4) the instance is

members.name: baseEnchantability, levelEnchantability, thresholdEnchantability, protectionName
members.note: folded into the rows' min_enchantability/max_enchantability/name per effect id

members.name: EnchantmentProtection
members.note: protectionType 2 (fall) switches the type to armor_feet; rows 0-4 carry the per-type EnumEnchantmentType

members.name: calcModifierDamage
members.note: the (6+lvl*lvl)/3 formula, the per-type source tests (fire, fall, explosion, projectile) and the canHarmInCreative guard (outOfWorld only) are reproduced; only the DamageSource kinds the port reaches are exercised

members.name: getName
members.note: runs only when a frame is drawn: clientframes cov-tipprot-s1 hovers a Protection IV, Fire Protection II chestplate in a large chest (frame judge 0 px over 25)

members.name: canApplyTogether
members.note: two protections of the same type refuse each other; fall pairs with everything (CAN_APPLY_TOGETHER rows 0-4)

members.name: getFireTimeForEntity
members.note: living_set_fire reads it for mobs (equipment) and the player twin (armour, on the server player's fire)

members.name: func_92092_a
members.note: getMaxEnchantmentLevel(blastProtection) over the entity's last active items, then v - floor(v * level * 0.15) (explosion.c's push for every living and the player; the S27 keeps var35). v is at most 1 and level at most 4, so the floor is always 0 and the push never changes in 1.7.10; ported as written. idx-armorench-s1 blows a creeper beside a Blast Protection IV chestplate.

notes: getFireTimeForEntity and func_92092_a would diverge the moment an entity wears enchanted armour; both call sites are marked partial rather than exact for that reason.
